_comment: Project-local file → skill/rule dispatch map, read by the agentic-harness file-dispatch hook (PreToolUse: Edit|Write). Canonical location: <repo>/.claude/file-skill-map.json — the hook CODE ships in the plugin, only this DATA is per-project. Each entry fires when an Edit/Write targets a path matching `pattern` (a JS regex SOURCE string, matched case-insensitively against the forward-slashed path). `skills` are invoked first; `rules` are file names in the rules-topical corpus to read first. Empty `map` = no-op.
